program.name: Advanced Mat
program.subject: Pilates
program.blurb: Long, advanced mat work: teasers, jackknives, boomerangs and control balance.
program.about: Pilates mat work at its hardest. The advanced order goes beyond the classical one: jackknife, boomerang, control balance, corkscrew and the full teaser, mixed with the abdominal and back series. Two orders alternate. Both later levels add reps.
